verdict.line: You lose early trades if she catches you near walls where her Tentacles spawn, but you win any extended fight once R (Realm of Death) is up.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's entire kit is built around Tentacles spawning on nearby impassible terrain via her Passive (Prophet of an Elder God) — she cannot threaten you the same way in open lane. Mordekaiser's R (Realm of Death) drags her into a separate dimension away from every Tentacle on the map, deleting her core damage source for the duration of the fight. That single interaction is why the head-to-head sits at 53.1% over 716 games despite the matchup being rated even in shape.

theirWindow.when: you're near a wall and W is up
theirWindow.what: She can leap in with W (Harsh Lesson, 4s cooldown) for free damage and wake nearby Tentacles to swing at you too. Back off walls/terrain edges when her W is available and you're pushed up.

yourWindow.what: Land E (Death's Grasp) to pull her off her Tentacles or just wait for her to engage, then R (Realm of Death) her immediately. In the other dimension she has zero Tentacle support, so it's a clean 1v1 in your favor.

powerCurve.note: Neither side has a hard cooldown edge yet

Teamfight value trades off vs her split push

start.why: Most-picked start in this matchup (55.2% WR, 79.5% pick) — the extra sustain and mana let you spam E-Q trades without worrying about Illaoi's Tentacle poke.

boots.why: Highest-performing boots here (54.7% WR, 73.2% pick) — Illaoi's damage is entirely physical (Tentacle swings, W, R), so flat armor reduction is the correct call, matching OP.GG's own tip to stack armor.

core.why: Most-picked core path (57.3% WR over 75 games) — the slow from Q/E makes it much harder for her to walk her W leap or Tentacle procs onto you.
Omnivamp turns every W (Indestructible) shield-and-heal cycle into sustained lane dominance against her poke.
Highest-frequency third item in the data — burn damage keeps ticking through her passive healing off Tentacle hits.

situational.when: she's building lifesteal or leaning on Tentacle sustain to out-heal your trades
you need more magic resist and want your W heal and Riftmaker omnivamp amplified
you're getting poked down early by Tentacle procs near objectives

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through repeated E-Q-auto trades and rewards the extended skirmishes this matchup turns into once R is live.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 87.9% of games here at 54.4% WR — you want to force early skirmishes and close out kills before she can lean on Tentacle sustain to survive.

playing.title: Fight her away from walls
playing.detail: Her Passive only spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain, so contest trades in open lane sections and near river choke points where terrain is sparse.

playing.title: Punish her W cooldown
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson (W) is only a 4s cooldown gap closer, not a stun — when she leaps in, answer with E (Death's Grasp) to pull her fully into your Q range.

playing.title: Save R for her all-in, not for poke
playing.detail: Realm of Death has a long cooldown (140s at rank 1, down to 80s at rank 5) — hold it until she commits to a real fight, then use it to strip her Tentacle support entirely.

playing.title: Track Darkness Rise stacks
playing.detail: Your Passive triggers a damage aura and move speed after 3 landed attacks/spells — chain E into Q into autos to flip it on before she can disengage.

playing.title: Don't panic if she rips your spirit
playing.detail: If her E (Test of Spirit) hits you, either kill the spirit fast or walk it away from Tentacles — staying near terrain while tethered lets nearby Tentacles pile onto you.

playing.title: Bank W shield, don't waste the heal
playing.detail: Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken — let it build during extended trades and only pop the heal when you're about to lose the exchange, not preemptively.

playing.title: Close games out post-6
playing.detail: Once R is up, look to force fights on cooldown; every all-in she takes without Tentacle backup is one you're favored to win outright.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the tactical reading on Realm of Death versus Illaoi's Tentacle passive is our own analysis, not sourced from the stats.
